item.title: Patch now: Plex Media Server: 4 flaws exploited together
item.description:
Plex Media Server: SSRF · admin required · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 1.43.3.10861

First step: Update Plex Media Server to 1.43.3.10861 or later.

Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, CVE-2026-96656
